verdict: Organic signals softening across all three entities; foundational work in progress.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, the last 28 days produced 380 combined Google Business Profile actions — the only active engagement channel, as no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads for any entity this period. GBP momentum is declining week-over-week at all three locations (down 50%, 30%, and 37% respectively in the most recent 7 days), with search clicks following the same downward pattern. Several foundational milestones — including a CRM data reconciliation and a web/SEO root-cause fix — are overdue and are the primary focus of work this period. Once those blockers clear, outreach sequencing and search visibility improvements are next in line, with paid channel activation to follow on the planned timeline.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
combined search clicks this period, the strongest organic reach signal available
week-over-week GBP decline across all three entities, a shared trend being actively addressed

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement and search visibility are declining across all three locations simultaneously, with zero paid channels active to offset the drop.
watch_item.fix: The web/SEO root-cause fix and CRM data reconciliation — both overdue from August 31 — are the immediate priority; resolving these unblocks outreach pipeline activation and sets the stage for paid channel launch.
